Overview.Name: G Shamili
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (80 g paneer) & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (50 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & spinach curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (60 g) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & grilled chicken (small portion)

Notes_and_Tips: Since PCOS is present, keep protein portions strong and reduce very oily foods.
Avoid eggs and fish as mentioned and focus more on paneer, dal and occasional chicken.
Irregular sleep can increase cravings, so keep dinner light and consistent.
For better physique results, make paneer or dal the main part of meals instead of extra rice.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent with a busy routine.
